children: Ethos addressed a TruStage carrier service disruption, stating no Ethos systems were breached and no material Q3 2026 impact is expected.
No Ethos systems were penetrated and no data was exfiltrated due to the TruStage July 2026 incident.
Ethos does not expect any material impact on Q3 2026 financials; effects were included in guidance from Aug 3, 2026.
No incremental lapse rates observed for TruStage policies in the July billing cycle versus pre-incident levels.
Company believes there are no material ongoing negative impacts to its business, financial condition, or results of operations.
